name: Classic Standard Business Cards
description: A classic business card printed on 300 gsm coated stock with a glossy UV finish. Smooth, vibrant, and designed to catch the light — and the eye.
subtitle:
Made from 110 lb coated stock at approximately 12.6pt thick, these cards have a coating on both sides for accurate, vibrant color reproduction. They are ideal for full-bleed backgrounds or designs with one white side and one full-color side.

Available options:

  • Square or rounded corners
  • Gloss or matte lamination
  • Hot foil stamping or custom die-cut shapes (5-7 business days)

  • Gloss, matte, starry, soft-touch, starry holographic, or rainbow holographic film
  • Hot foil stamping, custom die-cut shapes, cold foil, or raised UV (5-7 business days)

description: Basic cotton business card printed on premium cotton stock.
subtitle:
Premium cotton paper is uncoated on both sides, giving printed colors a soft, elegant appearance and a naturally tactile feel. For customers who care about a refined, nuanced color result, we strongly recommend this stock and its finishing options.

Because cotton paper absorbs ink, a dark full-bleed side placed against a white side may cause slight color transfer from friction when cards are stacked during shipping. This is within the normal range and can usually be removed with an eraser. We will do our best to minimize this possibility.

Available options:

  • Pantone color printing or full-bleed printing
  • Square or rounded corners, or custom die-cut shapes
  • Hot foil stamping, debossing, embossing, doming, laser cut-outs, edge coloring, double mounting, or NFC (5-7 business days)
